name: Vinales Car Wash
address: 1705 NW 7th St, Miami, FL 33125, United States

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Sunshine Translations
reviewSamples.text: I can't recommend this car wash enough! I have a Porsche, and I'm very picky about who I trust with it.  They do a phenomenal job here every single time. The service is fast, the staff is nice and professional, and the attention to detail is second to none. My car always looks immaculate and brand new when I leave. If you're looking for a car wash that truly cares about quality and takes great care of your car, this is the place!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Brian Johnson
reviewSamples.text: I was worried about all the bugs on the front of my car and windshield and they got them all taken off no problem. They even allowed me and my son to stay in the car who is severely autistic while they cleaned it removed all the bugs off of it. Great service in great experience!!!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Igor Fork
reviewSamples.text: Excellent work!! They making sure everything is perfect without question!! I never thought someone can put same care to my car like I do by my house ! 5star !!!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Leon Martmen
reviewSamples.text: Eddie did a good job. My car is super clean, they are professional & friendly. Recommended to anyone 5 out of 5.

reviewSamples.text: Got my Mustang nice and cleaned up… perfectly. Lenin did a great job.
